# Feature: Ice cleats — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #62 (Ice cleats) from Gear and Items before it is used in real levels. Effect: walk on ice without sliding. Unique: only gear that cancels a movement tile instead of crossing a hazard. Useful: collect orbs mid-ice and turn on ice that would slide you past. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** walk on ice without sliding.

**So that** collect orbs mid-ice and turn on ice that would slide you past.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Ice cleats for the first time in its teaching room (mech-62-ice-cleats-room). Teaching moment: First room: an orb sits in the middle of an ice strip that ends at a wall. A player who slides in without the cleats passes the orb and stops at the wall unable to come back for it, so the retry teaches that cleats change ice from a slide into floor you can stop on. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: While held in a slot, ice tiles behave as normal floor: no slide, you can stop and turn on them
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: All other movement is unchanged

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Ice cleats's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-62-ice-cleats-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/gear-and-items.yml mechanic #62.
